highlights: Even consumer durables grew at about 11% year-on-year.
RBI's proactive response through measures like the special FCNR (B) swap window generated record inflows, about $133 billion and helped stabilize the currency.
Deposits increased 18.8% year-on-year on a reported basis, including a 4 percentage point lift from special FCNR (B) window.
As you will see in our published deck, CASA grew at about 10.8% on an overall basis.
And within this, retail CASA growth was about 11.2% year-on-year compared to 9% a year ago, reflecting improving momentum.

willEndure: The full-quarter impact of the FCNR will be a headwind that will offset.
strengths: RBI's proactive response through measures like the special FCNR (B) swap window generated record inflows, about $133 billion and helped stabilize the currency.
weaknesses: The place where we always scramble around to make it is the last 2 miles on the small and marginal and weaker section that they have a dual qualification.
Our asset quality remains pristine, with GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower than year- on-year.
The only question was maybe why still our margin decline is similar to what other players are, why we are not outperforming even on a low base compared to where the other players are.
opportunities: New credit card issuances at 1.4 million have grown by nearly 19% quarter-on-quarter, indicating the expansion of the growth runway.
threats: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan: These are the items that are in play, positives, and the headwinds will be some full, full-quarter impact of whatever has come through in Q2.
But I don't want to call it a headwind.
